summary: Northwind AI reports usage token totals higher than expected (streaming + retries)
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer reports Redwood Usage dashboard + invoice preview shows ~18-25% more tokens than their internal estimates for same traffic.

Impact:
- Finance reconciliation blocked; escalation risk.

Context:
- Customer uses streaming. Client timeout 15s and retries once on timeout.
- Customer assumption: timed-out attempt should not be billed if they did not receive full response.

Initial hypothesis:
- Usage is counted per admitted attempt (retries are separate).
- Prompt tokens counted once admitted even if client cancels stream.
- Need to confirm there is no double-counting of completion tokens on partial streams.

Requested from customer:
- Sample request IDs + timeframe
- Retry/cancel rate metrics

Links:
- Slack: #support thread_ts=1739310605
- Slack: #eng-platform thread_ts=1739386202
- Gmail thread: 20250212-northwind-usage-token-count-mismatch-escalation (Vanessa Ortiz)
comments: 2025-02-12 Ben Carter: Created after escalation from CS. Assigning to Dev (eng-platform) to validate token accounting for streaming cancels + retry behavior.
2025-02-12 Dev Patel: Pulled 3 sample request_ids. completion tokens match streamed chunks; prompt tokens counted once per admitted attempt. No evidence of double counting. Main gap is comms/UI.
2025-02-13 Priya Natarajan: Please provide customer-facing blurb for (a) attempt-level accounting and (b) prompt tokens counted even if stream cancelled.

2025-02-14 Dev Patel: Plan: (1) publish KB entry, (2) add UI hint on Usage page clarifying request_id = attempt id; retries billed separately, (3) optional: expose retry grouping in export later. Tracking UI work in INT-330.
